what: [guard] lever-wiring-guard exempts tp_extend as runnable-exempt because scripts/ops/exit_mechanism_coverage.MECHANISMS has no detector for tp_revision rules; a live producer now exists (htf_pullback_trend_2h.monitor -> tp_revision rule tp_extend, PR #19615; and donchian_measured_move since 2026-10-07).
